COMPRESS-424.label: P
COMPRESS-424.reason: Same compression/decompression area and same theme of malformed or unsupported input handling in `BZip2CompressorInputStream`, but the mechanism differs. This report is about constructor-time exceptions from malformed bzip2 data, while the current failure is about `ZipArchiveInputStream.canReadEntryData()` / `getNextZipEntry()` needing to reject entries when compressed size is unknown. Useful regional signal for BZIP2-related code paths, but not the same fault.
